gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-002 identifies an exponent error in Cameron–Martin localization bounds and proposes stronger smoothness assumptions. It does not recognize the distinct dimension-correct H^gamma projection tail rate or the corresponding RKHS projection growth that make the displayed approximation claim false.

ISSUE-002 concerns dimension-dependent Cameron–Martin exponent calculations and smoothness restrictions. It contains no diagnosis of the missing 1/T normalization arising from the probability-design measure and therefore does not address the limiting covariance error.

The gold issue concerns the stochastic linearisation remainder g, the use of Condition B instead of the quadratic Condition C, and the resulting variance order. ISSUE-003 concerns a separate deterministic reaction-diffusion Taylor remainder m and an L4-versus-L2 estimate, so it does not diagnose the missing Condition C bound or its variance calculation.

The gold issue is the unjustified regularity of a pointwise mean-value selector and the need for an averaged potential. ISSUE-003 instead diagnoses an L4/L2 estimate for a Taylor remainder; it provides no recognition of measurable or C1 dependence of the selector or of the averaged-potential repair.

Both entries diagnose the same quadratic reaction-diffusion linearisation defect: the Taylor source is controlled through an L4 or stronger norm, while the proof incorrectly derives its L2 bound from an L2 estimate alone. ISSUE-003 explicitly supplies a valid energy-based repair establishing the quadratic remainder.
